title: risk_acceptances.json
description: Schema for .ai/blueteam/data/risk_acceptances.json — application-team-authored risk acceptance register. Skills read this file; they do not write it.

acceptances.description: Risk acceptance records; IDs are never reused or renumbered

id.description: Sequential identifier: RA-001, RA-002, etc. Never reused or renumbered.

finding_reference.description: Reference to the specific finding being accepted

assessment.description: The skill that produced the finding: threat_model | asvs_level2_security_assessment | cybersecurity_architecture_standard_compliance | dr_resilience_analysis | cybersecurity_tool_use

finding_id.description: The specific finding ID from the assessment report, e.g. T-001, FINDING-003, CAS-RULE-ID

tool.description: Required for tool-scan findings: trivy | trufflehog | osv-scanner; null for assessment findings

package.description: Required for CVE/dependency findings; null otherwise

package_version.description: Required for CVE/dependency findings; null otherwise

cas_rule.description: CAS rule ID if applicable; null otherwise

asvs_requirement.description: ASVS requirement ID if applicable; null otherwise

scope.description: Location of the inline risk acceptance marker in source code

file_path.description: Repo-relative path (forward slashes) of the file with the inline marker

line_reference.description: Line number or range; null only for whole-package CVE acceptances

risk_description.description: One sentence describing the specific risk being accepted; specific enough for a new developer

business_justification.description: Why remediation is not feasible or appropriate at this time

compensating_controls.description: At least one real compensating control; empty array is not valid

severity_at_acceptance.description: Severity of the finding at acceptance time; cannot be retroactively lowered

accepted_by.description: Full name of the person accepting the risk

accepted_by_role.description: Job title or role of the accepting person

review_date.description: ISO 8601 review due date; max 12 months for High, 6 months for Critical, 24 months for Medium/Low

pr_reference.description: PR number or URL; recommended for High/Critical

ghas_alert_id.description: GitHub Advanced Security alert ID for cross-referencing

status.description: pending = awaiting approval (treated as active finding); active = formally accepted; expired = past review_date (treated as active finding); withdrawn = revoked
